reuse.why: Extends the existing link precondition helper (assertBankAccountNotLinked) that every provider's link handler already calls, rather than adding checks per handler.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once, in the shared precondition, and no handler repeats it.

placement.why: The rule sits in the pre-existing guard in accounts/app.ts that runs before any link side effect, which is where the tree decides whether a link may proceed.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus tests and a release note; renaming the helper touches every link handler, which is justified by its widened meaning but adds churn.

maintainability.why: A single, well-named guard covers all providers (including those delegating through linkBankSyncAccount), so future link paths get the rule automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers, including linkFintegraAccount via linkBankSyncAccount, go through assertCanLinkBankAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the check exists once.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts assertCanLinkBankAccount, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkBankSyncAccount (Fintegra) and linkEnableBankingAccount.
